target: coalition-recorded hostile insurgent military incident incidence by province-week

target_surface.source_silence_semantics: No qualifying report in this military archive; not latent peace.

measurement_reason: The Afghan War Diary is itself a reporting/observation surface. Therefore Pineland's recorded-event layer is the preregistered primary prediction and latent state-based violence is diagnostic.
certification_basis: The project had not downloaded or parsed row-level Afghan War Diary CSV data before this certificate and mapping contract were written.
Only public documentation of the archive schema, coverage, and field meanings was consulted before sealing.
The 2007 UCDP surface is not being reused as the confirmatory target; the target source family is newly acquired coalition SIGACT reporting.
The mapping and holdout year are frozen before source event counts or province-week labels are observed.

pre_reveal_protocol_corrections.change: The absolute week straddling 2006-12-28 through 2007-01-03 is excluded from competitor training as well as forecast scoring. Training ends before week 156; scoring begins at week 157.
pre_reveal_protocol_corrections.scientific_reason: Prevent January 1-3, 2007 source reports from entering training through a calendar-straddling absolute week.
